scope: Handwritten live-workflow references for two new coordinate/delivery-fault variants of the authored flagship. Correlated scenes and repeat trials are not independent matches. No runtime/model access to this file.
policy_before_run: Live possession candidates selected at complete 60-second boundaries, retaining the source interval and original 15-second expiry. Other supported families retain their existing confirmation and 30-second expiry. No new workflow after the feed ends. Gate failures remain failures. After the first measured runs, scheduling v2 waits for the already-defined three-second recovery follow-up, and up to six seconds from shot start for a pending reported goal (confirmation/cancellation releases it sooner). No metric, expected ID, expiry or proposed timing threshold changes. Source state never waits for AI.
